question: Models can be used in which two ways according to the document?
ground_truth: Models can be used with agents (dynamically specified when creating an agent) or standalone (called directly for tasks like text generation, classification, or extraction).
answer_span: Models can be utilized in two ways: 1. **With agents** - Models can be dynamically specified when creating an agent. 2. **Standalone** - Models can be called directly (outside of the agent loop) for tasks like text generation, classification, or extraction without the need for an agent framework.
